problem: a,b,c,d = construct_rectangle(), e = construct_on_pline(c,a,d), e = construct_on_bline(a,d)
proof:
Solution:
1. Rectangle(a,b,c,d) => Length_a_b - Length_c_d & Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_d & Parallel(a,d,b,c)
2. Angle_b_a_d - Angle_b_a_e - Angle_d_a_e & Angle_a_d_e - Angle_d_a_e & Angle_a_d_c - Angle_a_d_e - Angle_c_d_e & Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_d => Angle_b_a_e - Angle_c_d_e
3. Length_a_b - Length_c_d & Length_a_e - Length_d_e & Angle_b_a_e - Angle_c_d_e => Congruent3(a,b,e,d,c,e)
4. Congruent3(a,b,e,d,c,e) => Length_b_e - Length_c_e
5. Parallel(a,d,b,c) & Parallel(a,d,c,e) => Parallel(b,c,c,e)
6. Parallel(b,c,c,e) => Collinear(b,c,e)
7. Length_b_e - Length_c_e & Collinear(b,c,e) => Midpoint(e,b,c)
